verdict.rationale: Decagon's integrations page claims no-code integration and identity-provider (Okta/Entra) syncing, and general product docs mention 'integrations' as a pillar, but the evidence pack lacks any specifics on Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom two-way ticket sync or standalone deployment mechanics — the actual technical docs are login-gated and unavailable. missing for 10: named connector list (Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom), details on bidirectional ticket/context sync, standalone mode specifics, and independent/hands-on confirmation since docs.decagon.ai is gated.
